grades.requirement:
Search for destinations that are practical for an Indian passport holder taking a first international vacation.

Check the Ministry of External Affairs' official visa information:

MEA — Visa Facility for Indian Nationals (https://www.mea.gov.in/vffin)

Also check:

MEA — Dos and Don'ts for Foreign Travel (https://www.mea.gov.in/dos-and-donts-for-foreign-travel)

Create a shortlist of 5 countries.

For each country, record:

Visa requirement for Indian ordinary passport holders.
Visa-free / e-visa / visa-on-arrival / regular visa category.
Passport-validity requirement.
Major entry conditions.
Approximate travel complexity.
Major attractions.
Suitability for a 10-day trip.

Do not select a country yet.
grades.reasoning:
The agent failed to fulfill the rubric requirements. Specifically:
1. It did not check the Ministry of External Affairs' official visa information (mea.gov.in/vffin or mea.gov.in/dos-and-donts-for-foreign-travel).
2. It did not create a formal shortlist of 5 countries.
3. For the countries it did look at (Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia), it did not record the required data points (passport-validity requirement, major entry conditions, travel complexity, suitability for a 10-day trip).
4. The agent focused almost exclusively on flight and hotel booking for a single destination (Thailand), ignoring the request to research and compare 5 destinations.

grades.requirement:
For each shortlisted country, locate its official immigration, foreign ministry, embassy, or consular website.

Do not rely on travel blogs for the final visa determination.

For each country, verify:

Visa type.
Eligibility.
Required documents.
Passport validity.
Application procedure.
Application fee information.
Processing procedure.
Proof-of-funds requirements, if applicable.
Accommodation/return-ticket requirements, if applicable.
Travel-insurance requirements, if applicable.

Record the exact official webpage used for each requirement.

Compare the five countries and select the destination with the best combination of:

Reasonable entry process.
Practical travel route from India.
Suitable attractions.
Manageable 10-day itinerary.
Reasonable overall complexity.
grades.reasoning: The agent attempted to research visa information for Thailand, Vietnam, and Malaysia but failed to fulfill the rubric requirements. Specifically, it did not provide a comprehensive list or comparison of five countries. Furthermore, for the destinations it did investigate, it failed to record the required information (visa type, eligibility, required documents, passport validity, application procedure, fee, processing, proof-of-funds, accommodation/return-ticket requirements, and travel-insurance) from official sources. The agent primarily focused on booking flights and hotels and did not document any formal visa compliance information as requested.
